The controls bound cost, state, and privacy consequence, not tool availability, and source cannot establish live provider capacity.

Measuring the real provider and reopening on observed abuse has greater lifecycle value than claiming unavailable bot resistance.

marginalValueDecisions.rationale: A standards-valid ordinary response could inflate denial time; canonicalization is bounded and reusable.
The provider is not expected to emit such a date and the consequence is bounded, but completed work is not rolled back.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Byte-for-byte reconstruction of the undocumented historical WASM build

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Immediate post-deployment official-page acquisition, terminal conversion, release, and privacy trace
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: Failed declared-profile acquisition, failure before a non-error terminal conversion, failed release, conditional analytics injection, or sensitive prose leaving the browser would have meaningful consequences. The earlier Safari/WebKit and Brave/Chromium records remain historical lifecycle and privacy evidence for their deployed revision but did not establish a terminal conversion, and the 2026-09-11 owner report records that the first repaired runtime still produced no terminal result. After the replacement source candidate deploys, repeat the official-page lifecycle and privacy review, bind one supported-browser terminal result to that deployed revision, verify browser-shaped responses contain no Cloudflare beacon or RUM marker, and return to held publication on failure; testing-profile success remains narrower than anti-bot evidence, and source no-transform policy does not prove provider analytics is disabled.

A real renewal defect could affect a long session, but source and adversarial tests cover renewal timing, bodyless PATCH behavior, fail-closed local termination, bounded lease expiry, and eventual cleanup. Record renewal when an ordinary session reaches the interval and roll back on an observed defect; deliberately waiting or building a harness adds little incremental assurance and must not hold operational completion.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Response-policy enforcement despite the static GitHub Pages origin
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: Missing CSP and Permissions-Policy would expose the main document to a realistic cross-origin and runtime-expansion failure. A small exact-path edge policy is reusable, live-verifiable, and removes that consequential deployment gap without changing the static origin.

Attaching hah.dev/* would couple unrelated portfolio pages and traffic to a Text to Lattice-specific Worker, consume its request allowance, and expand the failure blast radius. Four exact document routes plus the in-document CSP fallback protect the authorized launch surfaces with lower lifecycle and reliability cost.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Cloudflare official testing credentials for the demonstrable release
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: A real hostname-restricted widget would reduce automated capacity abuse, but no such pair has been supplied and qualified for this release, while indefinite unavailability would defeat the authorized demonstrator. Cloudflare's documented testing pair can exercise the official browser widget and Siteverify flow, while the direct preactivation probe establishes only Siteverify, lease, and release behavior. Explicit disclosure, exact-origin and bodyless boundaries, independent signing domains, per-location shaping, global daily admission, concurrent-lease caps, and bounded expiry contain financial, privacy, and state consequence but do not assure availability. It must not be represented as production anti-bot assurance.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Bespoke attestation bypass route or unsigned token mode
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: A new bypass endpoint or unsigned client assertion would add an undocumented public protocol, attack surface, and maintenance path. The provider's exact published test profile is narrower, recognizable, replaceable, and remains inside the existing Siteverify and signed-lease contract, even though its reusable dummy token can be sent without proving widget participation.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Public testing-token slot starvation and the 48-per-10-second edge rule
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: One client can use the allowed 16-request acquisition sequence to fill all eight slots and keep renewing them with the reusable public dummy token; the 48-per-10-second per-IP rule does not prevent that plausible sequence. The exact caps, four-hour lifetime, fail-closed free tier, browser-local prose, and no-paid-overage boundary limit consequence to demonstrator availability, which the interface does not assure. The edge rule remains recommended defense in depth under GATE-03, and observed abuse triggers requalification rather than a false pre-release anti-bot claim.

A slowly settling first asset could leave later healthy frame assets only a token verification window and create a recoverable deployment false negative. Independent bounded windows are cheap and improve lifecycle reliability.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Pinned Workerd redirect incompatibility in the Siteverify subrequest
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: The deployed runtime rejected redirect:error before Siteverify ran, making every realistic acquisition fail with HTTP 403. Manual redirect handling restores interoperability while the response validator still rejects and cancels every 3xx; a regression binds that fail-closed behavior.

marginalValueDecisions.finding: Replay of an ambiguous live lease acquisition probe
marginalValueDecisions.rationale: Retrying a non-idempotent grant after a transient response or timeout could consume more than one lease and obscure the production result. A single bounded acquisition attempt is cheap, prevents verifier-created capacity leakage, and leaves ordinary idempotent deployment probes retryable.
Normal interface paths cannot open two résumé modals at once. Reference-counting a shared body class would add coordination complexity for a programmatic-only, nonconsequential state.
